Every row of the record now has a pencil: it opens the entry's amount, memo, day and time and length (MoT); Save APPENDS a correction entry that names the transaction it corrects — the original entry, its hash and every link after it stay on the record exactly as they were (no change ever deletes an entry), and the table, the balance and the charts read the corrected values in the original's place. A corrected row carries a small ✎ with the correction's number (its tooltip lists every correction). Drawn by the chart engine on its canvas, so it follows pinch and pan.
